newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rice prices ease, market listless.
newsitem.headline: Thai rice prices ease, market listless.

text.p: Thai rice prices edged down this week in a listless market as demand slowed, traders said on Thursday.
Exporters and shippers bought only hand-to-mouth to cover their needs as only a small amount of vessels arrived at Thai ports to take consignments.
"I have nothing new to say. There are no fresh leads in the market as the prices were still high and buyers were sidelined," said a trader from a major US trading house.
"We expect the prices to come down further next week. New buying orders should emerge at the $325 level," she said.
Thai benchmark 100 percent B grade was indicated around $335-360 per tonne FOB Bangkok compared with $345-370 last week.
The 100 percent fragrant was steady at $690-710 per tonne on the same basis.
Thailand exported 1.7 million tonnes of rice between January 1-May 20 compared with more than two million tonnes during the same period last year.
